scope_rules.R1: speed word directly followed by a stage word -> that stage only
scope_rules.R2: stage word + 得/时/的时候 + speed word -> that stage only
scope_rules.R3: global cue (整个过程/全程/...) or no stage word in the clause -> every speed-eligible stage
scope_rules.R4: stage words present but not related to the speed word -> ambiguous, clarification required, no plan

global_scope_definition: all stage instances that support speed in the registered program: approach, descend, lift, transport, place, retreat (grasp has no speed dimension and is never changed by a speed word)
unchanged_stages_keep: shared normal level (v_max 0.12 m/s, w_max 1.0 rad/s), the frozen ordinary T5 plan
level_values: shared LEVEL_RANGES defaults: slow v_max 0.06 m/s with w_max = min(3.0, v/0.12) = 0.5; normal untouched
